primary_selection: All eight trials whose agent/trajectory.json appears under samples/trials in the already pinned TAB source tree; no exclusions based on observed responses or score values. Small release-sample census, not random sample.
declared_before: Retrieval or inspection of these trajectory bodies during this audit.
prior_exposure: Previous artifact audit examined db-wal-recovery verifier score and sample manifest; all reports identify this prior exposure. This is prospective sample freezing, not a blinded preregistration.
missingness: Retain all eight, including those with missing original scores. No manufactured model responses or score imputation.
primary_conflation_comparison: Only records with same original score field/version and observed task/source/response. A fully identified difference in A/B/C labels is required; indeterminate labels are not outcomes. Distinguish scalar reward aggregation from complete multi-field original score vector.
secondary_scope: Existing local NPB/BIPIA output availability inventory only unless a separate outcome-independent sample freeze is saved before reading response bodies. External benchmark and NPB proxy scores must not be pooled.
decision_gate: No new inference. GO requires consequential measurement limitation, not mere taxonomy or scalar aggregation. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE or NO-GO as supported.
